title: fix(lint)!: a lookup or master_detail into a stored-metadata-body table is refused at author time
body:
Fixes #24677

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

The authoring doors refuse a `lookup` or `master_detail` field whose `reference` is a stored-metadata-body table (`STORED_METADATA_BODY_OBJECTS`: `sys_metadata`, `sys_metadata_history`). This is the rule the maintainer ruled B on #24358 (「24358 同意」, then 「ok」 to its shape), pulled into 18.0 on 「都派」 (record 6282780489). Claim 6282819504.

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/lint`.** The expression rule's per-object pass (`runStackExpressionPasses` in `validate-expressions.ts`) refuses the field. It sits beside the #24316 hop refusal, keyed on that refusal's own collector, `storedMetadataBodyReferencesOf`, and its per-object index, so the two refusals judge one set.
  - The finding is located at the key the author edits: `object 'NAME' · field 'FIELD' reference`.
  - It is reported under the existing `expression-invalid` rule, so there is no new error code and no new registry entry. It rides the object crossing the rule already has (`runtimeTypes` is unchanged), so `os validate`, `os build` and the object save door give the same finding.
  - The message names the field, its type, the target and the rule, and ends on `STORED_METADATA_BODY_PRESCRIPTION`.
  - The pass runs after `masterDetailCount`, so an unreadable `reference` carrier is still refused by the pass that owned that verdict first. It reads the field's type from the walk's field-type index rather than off the field (the #5017 receiver meta-test pins the keys read off `f`).
- **`@objectstack/spec`.** The `FieldSchema.reference` describe and its TSDoc state the convention. This is the field's own `reference` at `field.zod.ts:1476`; `:989` is a grid cell column's. The reference pages were regenerated by `gen:docs` only (`content/docs/references/{data/field,data/object,system/migration}.mdx`, the describe line and nothing else).
- **Docs.** `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`: the `reference` rows of `lookup` / `master_detail`, plus a short section saying why the reference is refused.
- **Riders,** declared on #6367 (comment 6282830389). Test files only, ⛔ no `protocol.ts` change:
  - a door block in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, through the real `saveMetaItem` / `publishMetaItem`;
  - one row in the family enumeration pin `stored-metadata-body-family.pin.test.ts` (28 to 29).
- ⛔ **Not touched:** the engine guards (they stay, for every path that runs no authoring rule), object keys, `apiEnabled`, and error codes.

## Premises, re-measured

**P1: the doors accepted it.** Measured before the change, at base `4b114eda57`. Probes: one object carrying `meta`, a `lookup` or a `master_detail` into each family table; the controls point to `sys_user`.

| Door | Before (`4b114eda57`) | After (head `5e54169edc`) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `os validate` (CLI built from the tree) | 4/4 family probes exit 0; controls 2/2 exit 0 | 4/4 exit 1, refused at `object 'probe_carrier' · field 'meta' reference` under `expression-invalid`; controls 2/2 exit 0 |
| `os build` | 4/4 exit 0, artifact written; controls 2/2 exit 0 | 4/4 exit 1; controls 2/2 exit 0 |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` on a fresh `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh` backend, as the dev admin | 4/4 `200`; controls 2/2 `200`; gate-live control (a `sqrt(record.amount)` formula) `422` | 4/4 `422 INVALID_METADATA`, with the issue at `object 'probe_…' · field 'meta' reference` and the message ending on the prescription; controls 2/2 `200` |
| lint's object-door gate in process (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`) | 0 errors for all 4 and both controls | 1 error for each of the 4; 0 for the controls |

**P2: where the hop refusal runs.** `refuseStoredMetadataBodyHop` and its collector index live in `runStackExpressionPasses` (`validate-expressions.ts`, about `:1934` and `:1953` on base). It is registered as `validateStackExpressions` in `authoring-rules.ts`, with `commands: ALL`, `surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME` and `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'action', 'hook', 'object']`. On an object write, the gate's `runtimeWriteType` runs the passes over the object's own body. The new refusal is in that same per-object loop, so it reaches the same doors. P1's "after" column is that reading.

**P3: exposure.** A `git grep` for a family table as a `reference` (string literal, JSON, the `Field.lookup` / `Field.masterDetail` builders, `SystemObjectName.METADATA`):
- over `examples/**`, `packages/apps/**`, `packages/platform-objects/**`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/**` and `packages/qa/**` at `4b114eda57`: **0**. A positive control matched 3 of 3 synthetic lines.
- over the whole repository at `4b114eda57`: 0. On `origin/main` `a43405d596`: 0.
- control, references to an ordinary platform table over the same paths: **45 files** (36 in `platform-objects`, 4 in `app-showcase`, 1 in `app-todo`, 4 in `qa`).

The family objects themselves (`packages/metadata-core`) reference other tables (`sys_user`, `sys_package_version`, `sys_environment`), and that is unaffected. Neither premise failed, and the family set is unchanged.

## Tests

Run on head `5e54169edc`, each under `os-verify-lock.sh`, `--maxWorkers=2`:

| Package | Result |
|:---|:---|
| `@objectstack/lint` test | 149 files / 6965 passed |
| `@objectstack/lint` typecheck | exit 0 |
| `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` test | 251 passed + 3 skipped files / 20818 passed + 19 skipped |
| `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck | exit 0 |
| `@objectstack/spec` test (`--project local`) | 702 files / 21352 passed + 1 todo |
| `@objectstack/spec` typecheck | exit 0 |
| `@objectstack/objectql` (`--project local`) | 450 / 8490 |
| `@objectstack/platform-objects` | 79 / 1195 |
| `@objectstack/runtime` (`--project local`) | 430 / 6779 + 19 skipped |
| `@objectstack/cli` (`--project unit`; integration is declared to CI) | 314 / 4641 |
| `os validate` and `os build` on every example app (`app-crm`, `app-multi-package`, `app-showcase`, `app-todo`) | 8/8 exit 0 |

**Consumer sweep (G2).** No fixture outside `packages/lint` / `packages/spec` / `content/docs` went red, so there is no fixture for a rider. The family-iterating engine tests in `@objectstack/objectql` register objects directly and run no authoring rule (they are the installed-artifact path), and they are green.

**The new pins:**
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.stored-metadata-body-reference.test.ts`, 21 cases:
  - each family table × `lookup` / `master_detail` is refused at the build, at `os validate` / `os build` (`runAuthoringRules`), and at the object door with the build's own finding;
  - a `user` naming the family is refused too (the collector's type set);
  - a stored object re-saved is still refused;
  - a stored sibling is not charged (the differential);
  - the controls (`sys_user` and an app object, as `lookup` and as `master_detail`) draw nothing;
  - the hop refusal is unchanged beside it.
- The protocol door block (8 cases): 4 refusals with the `422` / `INVALID_METADATA` envelope and nothing landing; a draft's promotion refused; 2 controls saved; door finding equal to build finding.

## Ablation (G4)

Run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `6c2c70f3eb`. The later commits change only the message text and add a `user` pin; the mutated line is unchanged.
- **Mutation.** `if (!target || !type) continue;` became `if ('ablation-24677') continue;`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `e85a4327e28f` to `6564a909a8fd`.
  - The lint pins (they import `src`) went **15 red / 11 green** of the 26 cases then on the branch (the `user` pin came later). The 11 green are the 4 controls, the differential and the 6 hop pins.
  - The lint build's JS pass emitted the mutation, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 dist files. The DTS pass failed on the mutation itself (TS2872 / TS2345), which does not touch the JS the suite reads.
  - The protocol door block (it reads lint's `dist/`) went **6 red / 2 green**. The 2 green are the controls.
- **Restore.** By the tool's trap: blob back to `e85a4327e28f` (equal to HEAD), `git diff HEAD` empty, whole-tree `git status --porcelain` clean.
  - Lint was rebuilt (exit 0), and preflight `--absent` found the marker in 0 of 20 dist files.
  - The lint pins went 26/26 green and the door block 8/8. On the final head the lint pins are 27/27 (with the hop file's 6).

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths, on `5e54169edc`: 111 commands. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.
- `--ran`: `Run reconciliation — 111 derived, 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
  - `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exited 3 in the battery: a queue-timeout on the verify lock, so nothing was measured. It was re-run under the lock: exit 0, `1 ledger entr(ies) re-measured … none above its recorded number`.
  - Every other command exited 0. The clone was deepened (`--shallow-since=2026-07-13`) first.
- Local-only families: `check:dev-prereqs` exit 0 and `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated`: `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date` after `gen:docs`.
- `check:adr-0087-registration`: green, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-changeset-no-major`: green, no `major`.
- CI check-runs on this PR are not yet reported at open.

## Changeset

`.changeset/24677-reference-into-stored-metadata-body-refused.md`: `@objectstack/lint` `minor`, `@objectstack/spec` `patch` (the describe text only).
- It is BREAKING, an authoring narrowing, shipped `minor` under the launch-window convention. It carries the FROM / TO / fix mapping and the stored-row sentence.
- The stored-row sentence: a stored object row that already declares such a field keeps loading (rehydration runs no authoring rule, and the engine guards hold its reads). Its next active save or draft promotion is refused until the field is removed or retargeted. The lint pin "a stored object that already declares one is still refused on its next save" holds this.
- The ADR-0087 disposition is in the changeset.
- `.changeset/pre.json` on `main` is `{"mode": "exit", "tag": "next"}`. So this changeset is consumed by the release that leaves the `next` pre-release line, and nothing here changes that mode.

## Acceptance notes

- **`expression-invalid` for a field declaration.** The rule's id is the expression rule's, and that is where the ruling put the refusal ("where the hop refusal already runs"). The location (`… field 'FIELD' reference`) and the message carry the specifics.
- **A `user` field.** The collector's type set is `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES`, and the parse accepts an authored `reference` on a `user` field (measured: `ObjectSchema.safeParse` accepts `{ type: 'user', reference: 'sys_metadata' }`). So a `user` naming the family is refused the same way, and is pinned. The collector's docblock claimed otherwise and now says what was measured. A `tree` cannot name the family: the object schema refuses a foreign `tree` target.
- **Out of scope, reported to the seat rather than fixed here.** `os validate` accepts a `user` field whose `reference` names any other object (measured: `{ type: 'user', reference: 'probe_account' }`, exit 0). `Field.user`'s contract says "target fixed to the `sys_user` system object", and `referenceTargetOf` returns the authored carrier first.
- **Branch base.** The branch merged `origin/main` once (`37aa1d68d6`). `origin/main` has since moved 10 commits (`a43405d596`), and none of them touches this diff's files.
- **Review.** A `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record on the narrowing face is owed before the queue.
